test_title: PYST 3: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Town B is to the south of Town A. Town C is to the west of Town A. Town D is to the west of Town C. Town E is to the north of Town D and also to the south of Town F. What is the position of Town F with respect to Town D?
solution:
Given: 

Town B is to the south of Town A. 

Town C is to the west of Town A.

Town D is to the west of Town C.

Town E is to the north of Town D and also to the south of Town F. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9c77fd82e6f715cbc14deceed25420fb188c3a1078404453a0b6d7f0d756e98.png] 

So, Town F is **northwards** to Town D.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
